sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite sheet for Torii & Hutukara. Preserve approved identity and costume from reference1; reference2 defines ONLY chibi body proportions and detailed visible pixel-cluster 16-bit style; do not copy its main-hero clothes. Exactly EIGHT columns by FOUR rows =32 complete individual full-body poses, no text/grid/captions. WIDE 2:1 canvas with equally tall invisible square cells and generous transparent padding; never squeeze lower rows. Row1 faces DOWN/front, row2 LEFT, row3 BACK/up, row4 RIGHT. Eight consecutive poses per row form one complete smooth cycle. Big chibi head ~half total height, short torso/legs, consistent skeleton and anatomical scale across all cells, same head size, fixed foot baseline. Hard square pixel clusters, dark pixel outlines, coherent limited JRPG shading, detailed but crisp, no smooth painting or 3D render look. Transparent alpha background, no shadows/scenery/particles. Equipment stays physically strapped/held and changes perspective with the body, never floats. Entire body, hair, bow, sword and carried mask must remain inside each cell; compact weapons appropriate to this chibi scale. Character: Ryuchi Katana. Costume: same Ryuchi face as the approved main hero, warm light-brown skin, black cloth headwrap/beanie with folded cuff and small white zigzag, two tied cloth tails at rear; blue and deep-purple ninja jacket, gold waist belt, cyan stitching and small magenta/cyan tech panels, dark trousers and sturdy dark boots; a single curved steel katana in right hand and black/gold scabbard at LEFT hip; NO ivory mask worn, carried, or attached anywhere. Ryuchi Katana has no ivory mask anywhere; keep the black cloth headwrap and bare face. Action: IDLE. Eight subtle genuinely distinct breathing and blinking phases with grounded boots, small natural shoulders/cloth/strap shifts. Do not walk or attack. Katana is sheathed at left hip with right hand calmly resting near its grip; cloth headwrap tails move subtly. Final pose returns seamlessly to first.
